title: The Refundable Share of the Waiver Charge Financed With an Auto Loan
content:
The refundable share of the charge financed at funding, when waiver coverage on a loan of the Auto Loans line is closed out, is read from the scheduled installments credited to that loan over the last twelve months.

| Scheduled installments credited in the last twelve months | Refundable share |
|---|---|
| At least 12 | 100 percent |
| At least 8 but fewer than 12 | 95 percent |
| Fewer than 8 | 90 percent |

The refundable share is 100 percent where at least 12 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twelve months. It is 95 percent where at least 8 but fewer than 12 scheduled installments have been credited in that window. It is 90 percent where fewer than 8 have been credited in that window.

## The share worked on one charge

On a charge financed at funding of 695.00 USD, the three rows give 695.00, 660.25 and 625.50 respectively as the refundable share of that charge.

## The share at the edge of each row

A loan with exactly 12 scheduled installments credited in the last twelve months takes 100 percent. A loan with exactly 8 takes 95 percent. A loan with 7 takes 90 percent.

## What the count takes in

The count is of scheduled payments credited to that one auto loan in the twelve months ending on the day of the cancellation. Payments of other kinds credited to the loan in that window are not counted toward it.
